title: Plan migration with versioned entitlements and payment idempotency
context: Each tenant subscription has versioned entitlements. Seats must be integer 1..20. Subscription IDs are globally unique but tenant authorization must be enforced on every read/write. Callers send the exact expectedVersion; stale or future versions must be rejected. This method supports upgrades and downgrades and must charge/refund only the seat-count DELTA at prorated period price, rounded half-up to cents. A billing charge must be idempotent by requestId. Old rights must remain in force unless the new rights are atomically committed. The database has read-committed isolation. Billing is external to the DB transaction.
code: export async function changeEntitlements(req, { db, billing, makeRights }) {
data: makeRights({ tenantId, subscriptionId, seats, version: sub.version + 1 })

expected.why: Impossible conjunction and missing integer check permit out-of-range and fractional seats.
Subscription lookup without authenticated tenant filter exposes or changes another tenant's subscription.
Expected version must equal current version; greater/future values bypass optimistic-concurrency protection.
Bills all requested seats instead of the difference from existing seats, including on downgrades.
Floor rounding violates specified half-up cents policy for prorated amounts.
External payment call lacks idempotency key and failure-reconciliation boundary; retries can double-charge.
Removing old rights before new rights are durably committed and outside a DB transaction can leave a tenant without entitlements.
Version/seat update lacks tenant-scoped conditional version match and is not atomic with entitlement replacement.
